fixed.summary: A browser whose GPU runs only WebGPU's compatibility mode (an OpenGL ES or Direct3D 11 GPU) now runs the engine instead of reporting WebGPU unsupported: the engine asks for a compatibility adapter, the browser still gives a core adapter wherever it has one, and on a compatibility device the renderer runs its compat tier (no MSAA, no storage in the vertex stage outside the UI, the mode's limits and shader rules). The engine builds on origin-engine's wgpu fork (v30.0.2 with the upstream compatibility-mode patches) until wgpu releases them.

fixed: The web player's WebGPU check asks for an adapter once more when the browser's first answer is null, as Chrome's is while its GPU process starts on a Linux NVIDIA host.
